Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: Under clear, lighted nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling on a two-way, two-lane rural roadway with clearly visible white lane markings. Trees and dark vegetation lined both sides of the road, and a streetlight was visible ahead on the right side. The pavement was dry, and the ego vehicle's headlights illuminated the roadway ahead. An oncoming vehicle with bright headlights was approaching in the opposite-direction lane to the left. As the ego vehicle continued traveling straight within its lane, a large animal, possibly a deer, suddenly emerged from the left side of the roadway and began running across toward the right. The animal entered the ego vehicle's lane and collided with the front of the vehicle. The impact caused the animal to be projected upward and toward the right side of the roadway. It ultimately landed on the shoulder and disappeared from view. Following the collision, the ego vehicle continued forward for a short distance before decelerating and coming to a stop on the right shoulder. The vehicle's headlights remained illuminated, casting light onto the roadway ahead.

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: Under rainy conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the right lane of a two-way, two-lane rural roadway. The pavement was wet and reflective, with raindrops visible on the windshield. Dry grass, leafless trees, and utility poles lined both sides of the roadway. The ego vehicle was proceeding at a steady speed of approximately 40 to 45 miles per hour. As the ego vehicle approached a four-leg intersection, a black pickup truck entered the intersection from the left side roadway, traveling laterally from left to right in an attempt to cross through the intersection. At the same time, another black pickup truck was traveling toward the intersection in the opposite-direction lane to the left of the ego vehicle. As the laterally moving black pickup entered the intersection, the front of that pickup struck the right side of the oncoming black pickup, resulting in a side-impact collision within the intersection. Following the impact, debris including metal and plastic fragments scattered across the intersection and adjacent shoulder areas. Both pickup trucks were deflected toward the right shoulder relative to the ego vehicle's direction of travel and ultimately came to rest on the grassy roadside shoulder. The ego vehicle also maneuvered to the right and came to a stop along the right curb/shoulder area.
